tool_input.description: Regenerate manifests, typecheck, run the command

result:
Scheduled publishing is implemented; `bun run typecheck` and `bun test` pass (25 tests, 0 failures), and `bunx guren gate` is green on all six stages. Nothing is committed — the changes are in the working tree.

## Behaviours you might not expect

- **Omitting `publishAt` on edit clears the date.** This follows the contract ("absent or `null` means publish now"), so a client that updates only the title of a scheduled post will publish it.
- **An empty string is accepted as "publish now"**, because that is what an empty form field sends. Anything else that isn't a date and time with a zone is rejected with 422, including a bare local time like `2099-10-01T09:00:00`.
- **Non-authors get 404 on edit, update and delete of a scheduled post**, not 403, so the response doesn't confirm the post exists.
- **The home page hides scheduled posts from everyone, including the author.** Authors find theirs in the posts list.
- **The report replaces tabs and line breaks in a title with a space**, so a title can't split a row.
- **Visibility compares timestamps as text.** It is correct for values in the `toISOString()` form the app writes; a row written by hand in another format (for example with a space instead of `T`) could be misjudged on the same day.

## One change outside the feature

`bin/console.ts` now sends boot-time logging to stderr. Without it, running the report against a database with pending migrations printed an "Applied N migration(s)" line on stdout. This affects every console command, not just `posts:scheduled`.

## Summary

I added a nullable `published_at` column (`db/schema.ts` plus migration `db/migrations/20260929194411_add_published_at_to_posts`) and the visibility rule in `app/Models/Post.ts` (`isScheduled()`, `Post.visibleTo()`, `Post.scheduled()`), checked on every read so nothing has to run at publish time. `app/Http/Validators/PostValidator.ts` validates `publishAt`, and `app/Http/Controllers/PostController.ts` normalises it to UTC and applies the visibility rule to the list, search and post page; `app/Http/Controllers/HomeController.ts` filters the home page, and `app/Policies/PostPolicy.ts` returns 404 for scheduled posts to non-authors. `app/Http/Resources/PostResource.ts` now exposes `publishedAt` and a `scheduled` flag. The "Publish at" field is a new `resources/js/components/PublishAtField.tsx` used by `resources/js/pages/posts/New.tsx` and `Edit.tsx`, with scheduled notices in `Index.tsx` and `Show.tsx`. The report is `app/Console/Commands/PostsScheduledCommand.ts`, registered in `src/console.ts`, with the stderr change in `bin/console.ts`. Tests are in `tests/PostScheduling.test.ts`, the decision is recorded in `docs/adr/0002-schedule-posts-with-a-publish-time-checked-on-read.md`, and the `.guren/*.gen.ts` manifests are regenerated.
